serviceName: Custom domain for a SweetTech app
description: Points a subdomain you own at a SweetTech app (served by Vercel) and adds the Vercel ownership record.
variableDescription: sub: the subdomain label(s), e.g. desk; target: the label in front of vercel-dns.com, e.g. cname; verifyValue: the Vercel ownership value after its vc-domain-verify= prefix.
